title: Population estimates on July 1, by single year of age, Canada, the provinces and the territories, Men+ and Women+
source: Statistics Canada, Table 17-10-0005-01, Population estimates on July 1, by age and gender
attribution: Adapted from Statistics Canada, Population estimates on July 1, by age and gender, Table 17-10-0005-01, 1971 to 2026. This does not constitute an endorsement by Statistics Canada of this product.
citation: Statistics Canada. Table 17-10-0005-01 Population estimates on July 1, by age and gender. DOI: https://doi.org/10.25318/1710000501-eng

notes.age: Age at last birthday in years.
notes.revisions: Estimates are final intercensal up to 2020, final postcensal for 2021, 2022 and 2023, updated postcensal for 2024 and 2025, and preliminary postcensal for 2026.
notes.gender: Prior to 2021, the demographic estimates are based on the concept of sex at birth. Although gender and sex at birth are two different concepts, this change does not cause a significant break in the trend because the two concepts produce very similar distributions.
notes.genders: Men+ includes men (and/or boys), as well as some non-binary persons; Women+ includes women (and/or girls), as well as some non-binary persons.
notes.territories: Population estimates for Northwest Territories and Nunavut are presented separately from 1991. Prior to 1991, only estimates of population for Northwest Territories and Nunavut combined are available.
notes.ninety: Data for persons aged 90 to 100 years and older will be available from 2001.
notes.adapted: The territories are summed here into one place (Yukon, Northwest Territories and Nunavut), so the series runs unbroken from the first year. All genders is the sum of Men+ and Women+, which equals Statistics Canada's Total - gender in every cell.

places.name: The territories (Yukon, Northwest Territories and Nunavut together)
